subject: Taxes
title: The Tax Code Is 6,500 Pages Long
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Tax Code Is 6,500 Pages Long usable.

hook.text: The US Internal Revenue Code runs over 6,500 pages. Add regulations and rulings, and it exceeds 75,000 pages.

buildup.text: Every deduction, credit, and exemption has its own section, with rules, exceptions to rules.

discovery.text: The complexity exists because every special interest lobbies for its own provision.

twist.text: The tax prep industry earns $14 billion annually because the code is so complex.

climax.text: Complexity serves those who can afford accountants and hurts those who can't. The code is regressive by design.

punchline.text: 75,000 pages. $14 billion to decode. Complexity is the feature.

quiz.question: Roughly how much does the US tax preparation industry earn annually?
